title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：TV　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 TV 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the engineer ① watched the TV that no worker in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the watching was the whole of the year. The ② TV, meaning the set itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a TV, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ TV in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ TV at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A TV, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the TV was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the set. The ⑥ TV, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; TV, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a set and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ TV had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ TV of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of recording; TV, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ TV I remember is the set recorded in the manual, which closed in 1965 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ TV, my mother said in 1967, is the only set that improves by being recorded; every TV, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like a set. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 电视（指车间里每一台旁边的那一台）
B. n. 电视（指那台电视本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the TV 看这一台电视
D. n. 电视（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 电视之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的电视之事）
F. n. 电视（指说明书里写到、被记载的那一台）
G. n. 电视、声画（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 声画（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the TV that no worker in the workshop would have recorded
The TV, meaning the set itself and not the lever
the TV at the far bench
the TV was the whole of the matter
the TV had become a line in a manual
The TV of the whole thing
A TV, my mother said in 1967

answers.why: watch the TV 意为“看这一台电视”，1958 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯记载的一台电视做了一遍。
TV 意为“电视”，指那台电视本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
TV 意为“电视”，指车间里每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
TV 意为“电视”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
TV 意为“电视、声画”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这台声画就是那件事的全部。
TV 意为“声画”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那台电视，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
TV 意为“电视”，指说明书里写到、被记载的那一台，到 1963 年这一台成了说明书里的一行。
TV 意为“电视之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的电视之事是一处车间和三个年头的记载。
TV 意为“电视”，我记得的是说明书里记载过的那一台，1965 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一台。
TV 为抽象总称，母亲 1967 年说，电视是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的电视。
